item.title: Apple iPhone Duo: Design, Engineering, and Industry Impact
item.description: Apple’s design chiefs reveal the iPhone Duo’s notebook‑inspired proportions, custom hinge torque, unified UI and how it could reshape the foldable market for developers.

item.title: MacRumors & iMazing Giveaway: Win iPhone Duo + Software
item.description: Enter the MacRumors x iMazing giveaway for a chance to win the new iPhone Duo and a full iMazing license, plus ten extra software copies globally.

item.title: Xcode 27.1 Beta Brings iPhone Duo Support to Developers
item.description: Apple's Xcode 27.1 beta adds iPhone Duo SDKs, simulators, and macOS 26.6+ support, reshaping iOS development for the upcoming dual‑screen device.

item.title: Apple VP Tom Marieb Details iPhone Duo Durability
item.description: Apple’s VP Tom Marieb details the iPhone Duo’s hinge, durability testing, and display‑crease mitigation, raising the bar for foldable phones.

item.title: Apple Unveils iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo & New CEO
item.description: Apple's September 9 event reveals the iPhone 18 Pro with a mechanical aperture, the foldable iPhone Duo, and marks John Ternus' debut as CEO.

item.title: Apple Announces Foldable iPhone Duo & iPhone 18 Pro
item.description: Apple's 2026 event launches the foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max, Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and AirPods 5, reshaping mobile tech.

item.title: Apple & Shine Event: Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Watch 12
item.description: Apple’s Surprise & Shine livestream teases the iPhone Duo foldable, iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max, Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and AirPods 5, signaling a new era.

item.title: Apple Announces iPhone Duo: Dual‑Screen Foldable iPhone
item.description: Apple's iPhone Duo introduces a passport‑sized, dual‑screen design with a flexible inner display, marking the company's first foldable iPhone.

item.title: Apple iPhone Duo: First Foldable iPhone Unveiled
item.description: Apple is set to launch its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, sparking debate on design, pricing, and competition with Samsung's foldables.

item.title: Apple Store Outage Pre‑iPhone 18 Pro & Duo Fold
item.description: Apple’s online store went offline just before the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo foldable launch, raising questions about infrastructure readiness and event‑day reliability for millions of customers worldwide.

item.title: Apple’s iPhone Duo Leak & iPhone 18 Pro Colors Unveiled
item.description: Mark Gurman’s Bloomberg leak names Apple’s upcoming iPhone Duo and predicts the iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max color lineup ahead of the Surprise & Shine event.

item.title: Apple Launches iPhone Duo Foldable: Design & Tech
item.description: Apple’s Media Showcase reveals the iPhone Duo, its crease‑free folding display, Touch ID redesign, revamped Siri AI, and new Apple Watch models.

item.title: Apple’s iPhone Duo: The First Folding iPhone Launch
item.description: Apple unveils the iPhone Duo, its first folding smartphone, promising a book‑like design and media‑optimized experience amid a declining foldable market.

item.title: Apple Launches iPhone Duo: First Foldable iPhone
item.description: Apple's iPhone Duo brings a 5.4‑inch closed screen and a 7.6‑inch unfolded display, debuting Apple's foldable phone and reshaping the mobile market.
